metadata.description: Attacca 4.1 — context-engineering toolkit for Claude Code. Three plugins: attacca-core (workflow skills + hooks), attacca-security (audit gate), attacca-init (project interrogation & scaffolding).

plugins.name: attacca-core
plugins.description: Workflow skills (diagnose, tdd, code-review, quality-gate, prototype, grill-me, wrap-session, bdr-commit, more) + reviewer/researcher subagents + token-saving hooks.

plugins.name: attacca-security
plugins.description: Security audit skills (OWASP, supply-chain, SBOM), isolated-context security-auditor subagent, and a push gate that blocks git push without a fresh clean audit.

plugins.name: attacca-init
plugins.description: Project intake: /interrogate disambiguates vague build requests into a CONTEXT.md spec; /init-project scaffolds; /retrofit adopts existing repos; validate-idea falsifies the idea before you build any of it. Install alongside attacca-core.
